items.summary: Behind every stall at Punnami Ghat is a woman who has believed in her skills, her craft, and herself to live the lakhpati didi dream. The responsibility of taking charge, the cities that welcomed their work, and the confidence that grew with every step.

facts.text: Some of their annual turnover runs from ₹60 lakh to ₹1 crore.

A Lakhpati Didi is a woman from an SHG household with a sustainable annual household income of at least ₹1 lakh, the milestone at the centre of the Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi’s vision of six crore Lakhpati Didis by 2029.

Today the enterprise reports annual turnover of over ₹1 crore and paying GST of approximately 10 lacs per month and providing employment to 100 + members She is supplying her products through Lepakshi emporium showroom to many other cities.
Her business reports annual turnover of ₹60 lakh.

facts.text: TRAI has examined such services and observed that several applications aggregate and distribute scheduled linear TV channels to consumers, either as pre-installed applications on TV sets and other devices; or as downloadable mobile/smart TV applications; or as web-based applications accessible th…

Accordingly, the Authority on 6 th April 2026, had issued a Consultation Paper titled ‘Formulation of a Regulatory Framework for Application-based Linear Television Distribution (ALTD) Services (Including Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (FAST) Services)’ and solicited comments from stakeho…

Based on the comments and counter-comments received from stakeholders, inputs gathered during the OHD, and its own analysis, the Authority has finalised its Recommendations on the ‘Authorisation Framework for Application-based Linear Television Distribution (ALTD) Services’.

A light-touch authorisation framework has been recommended, with a national service area, an initial validity of 20 years renewable for successive periods of 10 years, an application processing fees of ₹10,000 and a one-time entry fee of ₹1 lakh, with no authorisation fee, bank guarantee or secur…

facts.text: The project, with a total project cost of ₹277.63 crore, focuses on developing a scalable, integrated green propulsion system for satellites and launch vehicles across the 5 mN to 300 N thrust class.
A key feature of the technology is its scalable architecture, serving propulsion requirements ranging from small satellite applications to higher-thrust systems.

The programme will build on this technology base through further engineering, system integration, testing and validation, advancing its performance, reliability and readiness for wider deployment across satellite and launch vehicle applications.

The project addresses an important requirement in the evolving space economy: propulsion systems that can support more efficient satellite operations while improving the safety and economics of space missions.
